author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for Animated Series
content: WE'RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS. JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: kayda_animation
title: Hiring Character Designer (Project Basis)

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers and More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We're looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. Positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we're open to collaboration / internships. Please send a PROFESSIONAL email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with name, location, position, resume/portfolio, rates, turnaround, software, payment method. NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! How to apply: Follow us @young.onion, comment with emoji and tag friend, send DM with portfolio or fill application form in bio. You can also mail us info@youngonion.in
